Field.Label: BLU Relay:
Field.Description: Relay Shelly BLU device messages to the plugin

Field.Label: Only BTHome advertisements from Shelly BLU devices are relayed, not other Bluetooth traffic. The relay script is synced to the device when it starts or reconnects. To force a re-sync, disable and re-enable communication for this device, or save once with BLU Relay unticked and again with it ticked.
